description: This file defines the ChartScrollControl class, which manages a GUI component for browsing through charts, including navigation buttons, key bindings, and display updates.

classes.name: ChartScrollControl
classes.description: A GUI component that provides scrolling controls (next/previous) for a chart repository, with key bindings and display info.

methods.name: ChartScrollControl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the control panel with navigation buttons and key bindings.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Navigates to the previous chart, wrapping around if at the start.

methods.name: showChart
methods.description: Displays the current chart based on the index and notifies the listener.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Navigates to the next chart, if available.

methods.name: bindKeyStrokeActions
methods.description: Binds keyboard shortcuts for navigation (left/right arrows).

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the GUI panel containing the control components.

methods.name: setInfoText
methods.description: Updates the label showing the current chart index and total count.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the index to zero and updates the display.
